# Van maintenance log

Kept by [[Jory Petrakis]] for the two network vans used by [[Thistle Run]].

- 2026-01-19: Van two, brake pads and rotors replaced, three days out of use.
- 2026-02-02: Van one, oil change and tire rotation.
- 2026-03-03: Both vans passed the annual safety inspection.
- 2026-04-14: Van one, windshield chip repaired.

Drivers record mileage and fuel each day on the clipboard in the cab. Report any warning light the same day, and do not drive a van with a brake warning.
